newsitem.title: DUBAI: Khatami to be sworn in as Iran president on Aug 3.
newsitem.headline: Khatami to be sworn in as Iran president on Aug 3.

text.p: Iran's president-elect Mohammad Khatami will be sworn in as president of the Islamic republic on August 3, Iranian radio reported on Sunday.

The radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the ceremony would take place at a public meeting of parliament, or Majlis, attended by all deputies, the head of the judiciary and members of the influential Guardian Council.

The signing of a decree formalizing Khatami's election by spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, which is required by the constitution, will take place before the swearing-in ceremony, the radio said.
Khatami won the presidential election by a wide margin in May.
